title: The Frequency Beta entry at /join is a short card centered under the header that grows in place: name, then email (saved automatically), then a photo, a town, and check your email to activate

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14: center the input window in the screen and shorten it. Name first, then an email field that appears under it as they start their name; once the email is filled it saves (show a save indicator) and a profile image upload appears above. Build the profile in 3-4 steps, then check their email to activate and consent. Follows SCAN-888.

detail: Under SITE_DESIGN=frequency the bare /join Beta entry (SCAN-888) is now three steps on one compact card (max 440px, a 24-30px headline, 48px fields and buttons, a three-dash progress indicator with a 1/3 count) that is centered both ways in the viewport space below the site header (the stage pads the bar's resting height, --fq-site-nav-rest, plus the same 24px both ends). Step 1 Join the beta grows in place: the name field shows first; at the first character the Email field slides in under it (a grid-rows height reveal, announced through aria-live); a valid address saves itself on blur, Enter, or Continue through the same calls the old email slide made (stashPendingInduction park, bounded captureLead, sendSignupLink), once per address with blur and Continue sharing one in-flight save, and a status line beside the Email label reads Saving… then Saved ✓, or an error with Retry. It does not save on a typing pause, so a half-typed but valid-looking address is never mailed. Once saved, a round Add a photo target opens above the name without taking focus (parked under fq_pending_avatar as before). Step 2 Where are you? keeps Turn on location (getBrowserPosition + reversePlace) with the typed-town typeahead fallback and Skip. Step 3 Check your email to activate says the link activates the account, with the consent line By activating you agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy (links to /terms and /privacy), Send it again, and Use a different email (back to step 1 with focus on the email). A resumed browser reopens step 1 with the name and the photo target and can continue without retyping the email. Each step's first control takes focus and the step is announced; reduced motion swaps and reveals in place. Same server actions and data, no SQL; /join/complete still applies it all after the link; DAWN and the /join?seq=, ?persona=, ?next= links are unchanged. Styles stay in the hand-kept site-pages-b.css (.jb-*, the old chips and bar rules removed), --fq- tokens only.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=p=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const j=r('components/frequency/site/pages/join/frequency-join.tsx');const c=r('app/themes/frequency/site-pages-b.css');const bad=[];for(const k of ['Join the beta','Where are you?','Check your email to activate','jb-reveal','Saving','Saved','Retry','href=\"/terms\"','href=\"/privacy\"','By activating you agree','aria-live','role=\"progressbar\"','sendSignupLink','stashPendingInduction','captureLead','reversePlace','fq_pending_avatar','onBlur'])if(!j.includes(k))bad.push('the beta entry lacks '+k);for(const k of ['What should we call you?','Add a face','jb-chips'])if(j.includes(k))bad.push('still the five-slide entry: '+k);if(!/jb-stage\{[^}]*align-items:center[^}]*--fq-site-nav-rest/.test(c))bad.push('the card is not centered under the header');if(!c.includes('@keyframes jbReveal')||!/prefers-reduced-motion[^}]*jb-reveal/.test(c))bad.push('no in-place reveal with a reduced-motion fallback');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-894: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
